findings.evidence: Both observation jobs directly collect manager.watch without catch/error dispatch. RecoveryGatedScreenDataManager.watch calls awaitReady(), which rethrows failed recovery; SQLite decoding/query failures can likewise escape. The execute Result failure path maps Msg.Failed, but it does not cover these observation jobs. Inspected failure tests demonstrate command failure handling rather than this production read/recovery branch.

findings.evidence: Pending-photo read crosses its worker dispatcher, then returns to the caller. saveObservation invokes the non-suspending managedPhotoId before LocalWorkspaceRepository.saveObservation enters withContext(ioDispatcher). managedPhotoId copies the complete image into a second buffer and synchronously hashes it without a coroutine cancellation callback. Functional tiny-image tests pass; PendingPhotoDispatcherTest checks read/delete/clear dispatching, not this hash.
findings.failedLink: Public Save → Store executor on mainContext → ProductionScreenDataManager.saveObservation → managedPhotoId → SHA-256, before the repository IO boundary.
findings.requirement: quality.md and constraints.performance require image work and hashing to stay off the main thread and remain cancellation-aware.
findings.smallestUsefulProof: Move identity-buffer/hash computation into an injected worker boundary and assert thread/context plus cancellation using a realistic image payload through public Save. Preserve existing atomic photo/link behavior.
findings.title: Photo identity hashing runs on the UI calling context
